principles: Human editorial review and explicit publish confirmation remain mandatory.
A publication package freezes the supplied evidence and source manifest by fingerprint; it does not prove source accuracy or authority.
Methodology, limitations, missing data, and conflicting evidence remain visible in public output.
Story sequence, map proximity, chart alignment, and temporal adjacency do not establish causation.
Corrections, supersessions, and retractions are prepared as explicit versioned records and never erase prior public versions.
No public write or WordPress publication is performed by the public preview endpoints.
